raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In Kimi-K2.5 MXFP4 graph decode on ROCm gfx95, the absorbed MLA key projection, RoPE and KV-cache write run as separate launches on the critical path, even though they share operands. AITER's `fused_fp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` does all three in one launch.

#38340 already added this fusion for FP8 `w_kc` (`fused_fp8_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla`, DSA path). This PR adds MXFP4 `w_kc` as a second branch of that same structure rather than a parallel path.

## Modifications

| Piece in `forward_mla_rocm.py` | FP8 `w_kc` (#38340, unchanged) | MXFP4 `w_kc` (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| Gate `_can_fuse_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache` | shared terms + TileLang/Triton DSA backend | shared terms + `_can_fuse_mxfp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache` |
| Kernel in `_fused_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache` | `fused_fp8_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` | `fused_fp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` |
| Call site in core | DSA branch | aiter-backend branch |

- Shared gate terms: gfx95 + AITER, kill-switch on, no DCP, has RoPE, no deep-gemm BMM, no LoRA on `kv_b_proj`. The gate then dispatches on `w_kc.dtype`.
- MXFP4 terms: graph decode only, aiter attention backend, no DSA, power-of-two `kv_lora_rank` / `qk_rope_head_dim`, `qk_nope_head_dim` a power of two in 32-256. Everything else keeps the split path.
- One `fuse_bmm_rope_cache` flag in prepare covers both dtypes; prepare skips the absorb and core runs the fused kernel.
- Q output dtype for both kernels comes from `_rope_cache_q_out_dtype`: with an FP8 cache, the aiter backend at 12 local heads keeps bf16 Q (Gluon bh16bn128); DSA always gets FP8 Q as before.
- `fused_fp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` is imported from `rocm_linear_utils` next to the FP8 kernel, behind the same gfx95 guard.
- Env var `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FUSE_MLA_PROJECTION_ROPE_CACHE` (default `true`) is kept and now gates the unified fused path for both dtypes. #38340 has no switch; keeping one switch on the shared gate gives an A/B and triage kill-switch (the MXFP4 kernel is not bit-exact with an FP8 cache, see below) without a second, MXFP4-only knob. The name is dtype-neutral, so no rename is needed. Default-on means FP8 behaviour is unchanged unless it is set to `false`.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4, 4x MI355X, TP4, AITER attention and MoE, FP8 KV cache, 1319 questions, 8-shot, 512 new tokens:

| Fusion off | Fusion on |
|---:|---:|
| 0.925 | 0.930 |

Kernel parity test (`test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_rocm_mla_fp4_absorb_rope_cache.py`, MI35x suite), on K2.5 TP8 shapes with random positions and cache slots, batch 1/7/64/200, FP8 and BF16 caches:
- Every KV-cache byte matches the split path, including untouched slots.
- Q matches bit for bit with a BF16 cache. With FP8, the RoPE half matches exactly and the BMM half is within one FP8 step (about 1% of values), because the split path rounds to BF16 first.
- The test fails if the fused call gets wrong positions, wrong cache slots, or no KV scale.

CPU gate tests (`test_rocm_mla_absorb_fusion_gate.py`, FP8 and MXFP4 branches of the unified gate and kernel dispatch): 11 passed.

The accuracy and speed numbers were measured before the refactor into #38340's structure. The MXFP4 path still makes the same kernel call with the same arguments and gate terms, so they still apply.

Re-measured on this head (`2d915aae0c`, after the refactor) with sgl-eval, on/off in parallel on one node:

| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FUSE_MLA_PROJECTION_ROPE_CACHE` | GSM8K | Truncated | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 97.27% | 0 | 0 |
| 0 | 96.82% | 0 | 0 |

- Command: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --num-threads 64 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --thinking --max-tokens 32768` (full 1319; Moonshot's thinking-mode sampling, no sgl-eval preset for K2.5).
- Within sampling noise (single-run stderr ~0.46 pp at temperature 1.0).
- Server: `amd/Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4`, TP4 per arm (GPUs 0-3 on, 4-7 off), `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --reasoning-parser kimi_k2 --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64` (cookbook MI35x TP4 recipe plus FP8 KV). ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kimi-K2.5 MXFP4, 4x MI355X, TP4, FP8 KV cache, 8192 in / 1024 out, concurrency 4, 20 requests after warm-up, same seed on both sides; only the switch differs:

| Metric | Fusion off | Fusion on | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Output throughput | 428.77 tok/s | 433.33 tok/s | +1.1% |
| Median TPOT | 8.81 ms | 8.68 ms | -1.5% |
| Median end-to-end latency | 8,455 ms | 8,329 ms | -1.5% |
| Median TTFT | 246.4 ms | 248.0 ms | +0.6% (decode-only change) |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""Fused MXFP4 MLA q absorb + RoPE + KV-cache write against the split path.
+
+On gfx950 graph decode, ``forward_absorb_rocm_core`` replaces the MXFP4 branch
+of ``rocm_absorb_q_bmm`` followed by ``_fused_rope_cat_and_cache`` with one
+``_fused_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache`` launch. Both paths must hand attention
+the same q and leave the same KV-cache bytes, at the out_cache_loc slots only.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace

+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.router import PlainPoolRouter
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import ForwardContext, forward_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+

+
+# Kimi-K2.5 MLA geometry at TP8 (64 heads / 8).
+HEADS = 8
+KV_LORA_RANK = 512
+QK_NOPE_HEAD_DIM = 128
+QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM = 64
+V_HEAD_DIM = 128
+NUM_SLOTS = 1024
+KIMI_K25_ROPE = dict(
+    max_position=262144,
+    base=50000,
+    rope_scaling={
+        "type": "yarn",
+        "factor": 64.0,
+        "original_max_position_embeddings": 4096,
+        "beta_fast": 1.0,
+        "beta_slow": 1.0,
+        "mscale": 1.0,
+        "mscale_all_dim": 1.0,
+    },
+    is_neox_style=False,
+)
+
+
+class _FakeKVPool:
+    def __init__(self, kv_buffer: torch.Tensor):
+        self.kv_buffer = kv_buffer
+        self.start_layer = 0
+        self.layer_transfer_counter = None
+        self.layer_router = PlainPoolRouter(self, "full")
+
+    def get_key_buffer(self, _layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.kv_buffer
+

+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import fp8_dtype
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.quark.utils import quark_post_load_weights
+        from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope_wrapper

+            kv_b = torch.randn(

+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device="cuda",
+            generator=g,

+            batch,
+            KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device="cuda",

+            dtype=torch.int64,

+    def _kv_buffer(self, kv_cache_dtype: str):
+        # Random bytes, so a write to a wrong slot or a missed write both show.
+        dtype = self.fp8_dtype if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8_e4m3" else torch.bfloat16
+        width = KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM
+        raw = torch.randint(
+            0, 64, (NUM_SLOTS, 1, width * dtype.itemsize), dtype=torch.uint8
+        )
+        return raw.cuda().view(dtype)
+
+    def _run(self, fn, kv_buffer):
+        backend = SimpleNamespace(token_to_kv_pool=_FakeKVPool(kv_buffer))
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=backend)):
+            return fn()
+
+    def test_matches_split_absorb_then_rope_cache(self):
+        for kv_cache_dtype in ("fp8_e4m3", "auto"):
+            for batch in (1, 7, 64, 200):
+                with self.subTest(kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype, batch=batch):
+                    self._check(kv_cache_dtype, batch)
+
+    def _check(self, kv_cache_dtype: str, batch: int):
+        attn = self._attn(kv_cache_dtype)
+        q_nope, q_pe, k_nope, k_pe, positions, loc = self._inputs(batch)
+        split_kv = self._kv_buffer(kv_cache_dtype)
+        fused_kv = split_kv.clone()
+
+        rope_cache_args = dict(
+            attn=attn,
+            q_pe=q_pe,
+            k_nope=k_nope,
+            k_pe=k_pe,
+            positions=positions,
+            out_cache_loc=loc,
+        )
+
+        def split():
+            q_nope_out = self.mla.rocm_absorb_q_bmm(
+                attn=attn, q_nope=q_nope, is_capture_mode=True
+            ).transpose(0, 1)
+            return self.mla._fused_rope_cat_and_cache(
+                q_nope_out=q_nope_out, **rope_cache_args
+            )[0]
+
+        def fused():
+            return self.mla._fused_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache(
+                q_nope=q_nope, **rope_cache_args
+            )[0]
+
+        q_split = self._run(split, split_kv)
+        q_fused = self._run(fused, fused_kv)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+        self.assertEqual(q_fused.dtype, q_split.dtype)
+        self.assertEqual(q_fused.shape, (batch, HEADS, KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(fused_kv.view(torch.uint8), split_kv.view(torch.uint8)),
+            "KV-cache bytes differ",
+        )
+        if kv_cache_dtype != "fp8_e4m3":
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(q_fused, q_split), "q differs")

+        # The rope half shares no arithmetic with the BMM, so it matches bit for bit.
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(
+                q_fused[..., KV_LORA_RANK:].view(torch.uint8),

+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            q_fused[..., :KV_LORA_RANK].float(),
+            q_split[..., :KV_LORA_RANK].float(),
+            rtol=0.125,
+            atol=2**-9,
+        )
+

+    unittest.main()

+            kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
+            current_attention_backend="aiter" if is_mxfp4 else "dsa",
+            w_kc=torch.empty(num_heads, 4, 2, dtype=w_kc_dtype),
+            w_scale_k=torch.empty(num_heads, 4, 1, dtype=torch.uint8),
+            w_scale=torch.empty(1),
+            rotary_emb=SimpleNamespace(
+                cos_cache=None, sin_cache=None, is_neox_style=False
+            ),
+            attn_mqa=SimpleNamespace(layer_id=0, k_scale=None),
+        )
+        q_nope = torch.empty(3, num_heads, 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        fp4_kernel = mock.Mock()
+        fp8_kernel = mock.Mock()
+        layers = mock.Mock()
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mla_rocm,
+                "fused_fp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla",
+                fp4_kernel,
+                create=True,
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mla_rocm,
+                "fused_fp8_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla",
+                fp8_kernel,
+                create=True,
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(forward_mla_rocm, "get_kv_layers", return_value=layers),
+        ):
+            forward_mla_rocm._fused_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache(
+                attn,
+                q_nope=q_nope,
+                q_pe=None,
+                k_nope=None,
+                k_pe=None,
+                positions=None,
+                out_cache_loc=torch.zeros(3, dtype=torch.int64),
+            )
+        kernel, unused = (
+            (fp4_kernel, fp8_kernel) if is_mxfp4 else (fp8_kernel, fp4_kernel)
+        )
+        unused.assert_not_called()
+        return kernel.call_args.kwargs["q_out_dtype"]
+
+    def test_fp8_cache_with_12_heads_keeps_bf16_q(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._q_out_dtype(12, "fp8_e4m3"), torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertEqual(self._q_out_dtype(8, "fp8_e4m3"), forward_mla_rocm.fp8_dtype)
+        self.assertEqual(self._q_out_dtype(12, "auto"), torch.bfloat16)
+
+    def test_fp8_w_kc_keeps_fp8_q_at_12_heads(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._q_out_dtype(12, "fp8_e4m3", w_kc_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+            forward_mla_rocm.fp8_dtype,
+        )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
